question: John Dramani Mahama has been sworn in as the President of which country in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• John Dramani Mahama served as the President of Ghana from 2012 to 2017 and was re-elected as President in January 2025.
 
• Ghana is a West African country known for its stable democracy and rich cultural heritage.
 
• John Dramani Mahama is a member of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), a major political party in Ghana.
 
• He previously held the position of Vice President from 2009 to 2012 and became President following the death of former President John Atta Mills.
 
• Mahama has been credited with infrastructural development in Ghana during his tenure and is recognized for his contributions to education and economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Morocco:**

 
 
• Morocco is located in North Africa and is known for its historic cities like Marrakesh, Casablanca, and Fes.
 
• The country operates as a constitutional monarchy with King Mohammed VI as the head of state.
 
• Morocco has been working on renewable energy projects and is a leader in solar energy development in the region.
 
 
 
• **South Africa:**
 
 
• South Africa is located at the southern tip of Africa and is known for its diverse cultures, languages, and landscapes.
 
• The country has three capitals: Pretoria (administrative), Cape Town (legislative), and Bloemfontein (judicial).
 
• South Africa is a major player in the mining industry, being one of the largest producers of gold and platinum.
 
 
 
• **Kenya:**
 
 
• Kenya is an East African country famous for its wildlife safaris and the Great Rift Valley.
 
• The country operates as a presidential republic, with Nairobi as its capital and largest city.
 
• Kenya is a significant exporter of tea and coffee and is working on economic diversification through technology and manufacturing.
